notes: Official-source RAG seed for SA_E_VISA, the self-service VisitSaudi Tourist eVisa only. It excludes visa on arrival, embassy and sponsored visas, Hajj, work, study, and residence products.

chunks.title: SA_E_VISA is the VisitSaudi self-service Tourist eVisa
chunks.content: SA_E_VISA represents only the Ministry of Tourism self-service Tourist eVisa at https://visa.visitsaudi.com/. It is not a generic Saudi visa, visa-on-arrival workflow, embassy visa, sponsor-issued visit visa, Hajj visa, work visa, study visa, or residence product. VIZA must route any applicant who cannot use the live VisitSaudi nationality and passport-type eligibility flow to a separate product or the appropriate official authority rather than changing the scope of SA_E_VISA.

chunks.title: Live VisitSaudi eligibility and passport validity control the route
chunks.content: Eligibility is controlled by the current nationality and passport-type choices in the VisitSaudi registration flow and must be checked again before submission because the live list can change. The VisitSaudi terms require a valid passport from a permitted country with at least six months remaining on the date of entry. The traveller must use the same passport at the Saudi border that was used for the eVisa application. Official sources: https://visa.visitsaudi.com/Registration/Verify ; https://visa.visitsaudi.com/Home/TermsConditions

chunks.title: Tourist eVisa validity and permitted use
chunks.content: VisitSaudi states that the eVisa is normally valid for one year, permits multiple entries unless the issued eVisa states otherwise, and allows a maximum stay of three months. It cannot be extended. The official portal describes tourism activities, events, leisure, family and relative visits, and Umrah excluding Hajj within the Tourist eVisa program. The eVisa is not valid for paid employment, study, or Hajj. The issued eVisa and current official terms control if they differ from general guidance. Official sources: https://visa.visitsaudi.com/ ; https://visa.visitsaudi.com/Home/TermsConditions

chunks.title: Adult authority, minor applications, and border conditions
chunks.content: A user of the VisitSaudi eVisa service must be at least 18. An adult may apply for a minor only with authority to do so, and the application captures the minor's guardian relationship. Approval does not remove border controls: the traveller must carry the eVisa as directed, use the application passport, comply with Saudi law, and may have biometrics captured on arrival. Official source: https://visa.visitsaudi.com/Home/TermsConditions

chunks.title: VisitSaudi channel and reconstruction limit
chunks.content: The canonical channel is the VisitSaudi eVisa portal at https://visa.visitsaudi.com/. Public registration pages and official client templates establish the semantic answer inventory, but an activated authenticated application is still required to verify exact page order, requiredness, lookup labels and codes, validation, and transfer behavior. Treat SA_E_VISA as an official-source reconstruction with live-login QA pending; state uncertainty instead of inventing a portal value.

chunks.title: Applicant, guardian, and passport answers
chunks.content: Collect nationality; passport-exact given, father, and family names while preserving synchronized English and official Arabic values internally; gender; date, country, and city of birth; religion; marital status; profession; and whether the applicant is a minor. For a minor, collect guardian name and relationship and resolve them to the linked application during submission. Passport answers include number, issuing country, place and date of issue, and expiry date. Passport type is locked to the product-supported regular passport rather than presented as a route switch. Official sources: https://visa.visitsaudi.com/Registration/Verify ; https://visa.visitsaudi.com/Home/TermsConditions

chunks.title: Residence, correspondence, and accommodation answers
chunks.content: Collect country, city, postal code when applicable, and residential address; applicant email for visa correspondence; phone country calling code and number; whether that number receives WhatsApp; and a separate WhatsApp calling code and number when it does not. Collect the official purpose-of-visit lookup value within the Tourist eVisa product. Accommodation is one conditional branch: hotel or commercial accommodation requires property name, address, and city; private residence requires the residence address, city, and residence or host name. Exact authenticated lookup values and derived place-search transfers remain live-login-QA pending. Official source: https://visa.visitsaudi.com/

chunks.title: Photograph and passport copy are document slots
chunks.content: The personal photograph and passport biodata page belong to application_documents and must not be stored as file-path answers in the visa form schema. VisitSaudi publishes a dedicated photograph specification, including a 200 by 200 pixel image, 5 to 100 KB file size, white unpatterned background, recent likeness, centered face, and specified face proportion. Use the current official specification at upload time: https://visa.visitsaudi.com/Home/PhotoSpecifications

chunks.title: Portal operations are not applicant-answer fields
chunks.content: VisitSaudi account activation, authentication, session state, anti-automation challenge handling, integrated insurance, and government-fee payment are VIZA workflow responsibilities. They must not appear in visa_form_fields or be requested as ordinary applicant answers. The applicant-facing schema contains only reusable application facts and keeps upload state in application_documents. Official service and terms: https://visa.visitsaudi.com/ ; https://visa.visitsaudi.com/Home/TermsConditions

chunks.title: Passport and identity answers must follow the requested document field
chunks.content: Copy names, passport number, nationality, birth facts, issuing country, place of issue, issue date, and expiry date from the matching field on the valid passport. Do not substitute the issuing authority, pickup city, residence, or destination when the form asks for place or country of issue. Preserve official English and Arabic value pairs internally where VisitSaudi exposes both, but show only the applicant's selected interface language during entry. Closed-list values must use the authenticated portal's current label and code rather than a guessed synonym. Official source: https://visa.visitsaudi.com/Registration/Verify
